mapper.select: SELECT chat_num, lost_num, found_num, user_id_a, user_id_b, created_at FROM chat_room WHERE ( (#{lostNum} IS NOT NULL AND lost_num = #{lostNum}) OR (#{foundNum} IS NOT NULL AND found_num = #{foundNum}) ) AND ( (user_id_a = #{userIdA} AND user_id_b = #{userIdB}) OR (user_id_a = #{userIdB} AND user_id_b = #{userIdA}) ) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room ( lost_num, found_num, user_id_a, user_id_b ) VALUES ( #{lostNum}, #{foundNum}, #{userIdA}, #{userIdB} )
mapper.select: SELECT chat_num, lost_num, found_num, user_id_a, user_id_b, created_at FROM chat_room WHERE chat_num = #{chatNum}

SELECT cr.chat_num, cr.lost_num, cr.found_num, cr.user_id_a, cr.user_id_b, cr.created_at,
CASE WHEN cr.found_num IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(f.is_deleted, 1) = 0 THEN f.fd_sbjt WHEN cr.lost_num IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(l.is_deleted, 1) = 0 THEN l.lst_sbjt ELSE '삭제된 게시글입니다.' END AS title,
CASE WHEN cr.found_num IS NOT NULL THEN IFNULL(f.is_deleted, 1) WHEN cr.lost_num IS NOT NULL THEN IFNULL(l.is_deleted, 1) ELSE 1 END AS is_deleted,
CASE WHEN cr.user_id_a = #{loginId} THEN ub.name ELSE ua.name END AS user_name
FROM chat_room cr
LEFT JOIN found f ON cr.found_num = f.num
LEFT JOIN lost l ON cr.lost_num = l.num
LEFT JOIN user ua ON cr.user_id_a = ua.id
LEFT JOIN user ub ON cr.user_id_b = ub.id
WHERE cr.user_id_a = #{loginId} OR cr.user_id_b = #{loginId}
ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC

SELECT m.message_num, m.chat_num, m.sender_id, m.content, m.created_at,
CASE WHEN m.sender_id = cr.user_id_a THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(cr.user_b_last_read, 0) >= m.message_num THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN m.sender_id = cr.user_id_b THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(cr.user_a_last_read, 0) >= m.message_num THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS is_read,
f.file_num, f.message_num AS file_message_num, f.original_name, f.save_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, f.created_at AS file_created_at
FROM chat_message m
JOIN chat_room cr ON m.chat_num = cr.chat_num
LEFT JOIN chat_file f ON m.message_num = f.message_num
WHERE m.chat_num = #{chatNum}
ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.message_num ASC, f.file_num ASC
SELECT file_num, message_num, original_name, save_name, file_path, file_size, created_at FROM chat_file WHERE message_num = #{messageNum} ORDER BY file_num ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_file ( message_num, original_name, save_name, file_path, file_size ) VALUES ( #{messageNum}, #{originalName}, #{saveName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize} )
